profile.headline: Software Engineer | Interaction Design Enthusiast
profile.geoLocationName: West Palm Beach, Florida, United States

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Palm Beach Gardens, Florida, United States
positions.description:
• Maintained company's web-based applications and tools with the Angular framework and enforced application stability through 80+ unit tests
• One of the developers who pioneered behavior driven development for one of the company’s main applications using python’s behave framework
• Implemented 135+ step implementations, covering 4 main application features, running in headless chrome using python’s behave framework and selenium webdriver
• Aided in the upgrade of a servicing web-based application from AngularJS to Angular 9 for the Field Systems team

positions.title: Newsletter & Social Media Content Coordinator
positions.description:
• Created and administered studio newsletter via MailChimp
• Established studio social media content and theme for Instagram, and increased online social presence for the art studio

positions.title: Studio Attendant
positions.description:
• Managed print orders, hosted arts and crafts events
• Created internal and external sign material for the studio's classes and workshops

positions.title: Summer 2019 User Experience Intern
positions.description:
• Led a project defining the role of augmented reality technology within a telecommunications company
• Devised an AR prototype that showcased 4 different digital tools for iOS and Android using Unity and the built-in Vuforia engine to provide a foundation for further development of the technology
• Programmed the following user interactions to facilitate discovery and learning of telecommunication tools: one-touch rotation around the object’s local Y axis and two-touch object resize up to 3 times the object’s original size
• Validated the design and implementation of the AR prototype through 3 phases of usability testing across 11 users
• Detailed a design guideline for augmented reality applications as an accessory to the company's developing design system.

positions.title: Computer Graphics Undergraduate Research Assistant
positions.description:
• Explored algorithms and procedures to simulate the growth of 5 different species of trees in a 3D graphic environment
• Implemented concepts include matrix transformations and object-oriented programming to achieve graphical representations of plant life in digital form.
